finalOutput:
The Todo app is in `todo_anthropic-claude-haiku-5-5_01.html`, a single self-contained file with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. I did not open it in a browser, so the behaviour below is from reading the code, not from running it.

It covers each requirement:
- **Add:** type in the input and press Add or Enter. Empty or whitespace-only input is ignored, and text is capped at 200 characters.
- **Complete:** each item has a checkbox. Checked items show with strikethrough and grey text.
- **Delete:** each item has a × button.
- **Filter:** All / Active / Completed buttons, with the active one highlighted.
- **Persist:** todos are saved to `localStorage` under the key `todo-app-items` and reloaded on page open. Corrupt or missing data falls back to an empty list.

Beyond the brief, the footer shows an "N items left" count and a "Clear completed" button that appears only when something is completed. The layout is responsive, and the page has basic accessibility labels.

{"path":"todo_anthropic-claude-haiku-5-5_01.html","edit_description":"Replace the entire contents of this file with a complete, self-contained single-file Todo app (HTML, CSS, and JS all inline, no external dependencies). Requirements:
- Full HTML5 document, lang="en", meta charset UTF-8, viewport meta, title "Todo App".
- Header with title and a form containing a text input (placeholder "What needs to be done?", required, maxlength 200) and an "Add" submit button. Submitting trims the value, ignores empty input, adds a new todo, clears the input and refocuses it.
- Todo list: each item has a checkbox toggling completed state, the text (shown with line-through and muted color when completed), and a delete button (aria-label "Delete", "×" text). Double-click on text is optional; keep it simple.
- Filter buttons: All / Active / Completed, with the current one marked active (aria-pressed and a CSS class). Filter applies to the rendered list.
- Footer shows count of remaining active items ("N items left", singular "1 item left"), and a "Clear completed" button that removes completed todos (hidden or disabled when none completed).
- Empty state message when there are no todos for the current filter.
- Persistence: store the array of todos {id, text, completed, createdAt} in localStorage under key "todo-app-items". Load on startup with try/catch for corrupted JSON. Save after every mutation.
- Use ids via Date.now() plus a counter or crypto.randomUUID fallback. Escape rendered text by building DOM with textContent (no innerHTML with user data).
- Clean modern CSS: centered card, max-width ~520px, system font stack, light gray background, subtle shadows, responsive, focus-visible styles, filter active state styling.
- Use camelCase function and variable names. Vanilla JS in a single IIFE or module-free script at end of body.
Output only the file contents."}
